proves.claim: A case whose error is only "test failed" is named by the first error line of its phase output.

cli.logic-show-gate.generic-case-error-l.why: Without it, a gate that crashed before any case would show only "test failed" and leave the builder nothing to fix from.

proves.claim: A case with its own error keeps that text and gets no extra output line.

cli.logic-show-gate.specific-case-error-.why: Without it, the output-line fallback could overwrite a specific error a builder can already act on.

proves.claim: The GATE_RED refusal for a generic test failed case contains the output error line.

cli.io-submit-pulled.generic-error-refus.why: Without it, the refusal ship prints would still say only test failed while show names the cause.
